articles.title: Israel kills two MSF staff in targeted strike on Gaza clinic
articles.summary: An Israeli strike on a clinic operated by Doctors Without Borders (MSF) in Gaza has killed two watchmen.

articles.title: Israeli military claims MSF workers killed in Gaza strike were Hamas members
articles.summary: The Israeli military has said the two Doctors Without Borders (MSF) workers -- Ahmed Sufyan Muhammad Ali Abu Hasira and Ma’ad Yousef Ali Sabeh -- killed in an air strike on a clinic in Gaza City were members of Hamas. In a statement, the military said Ali Sabeh was as an artillery unit commander in Hamas’s armed wing, without providing any evidence. It denied targeting a hospital or damaging medical infrastructure, saying precautions had been taken to minimise civilian casualties.

articles.title: Iran war live: Italy says drone in deadly Kuwait attack was made in Iran
articles.summary: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani says the drone behind the deadly Kuwait strike was made in Iran.

articles.title: Drone that killed two Italians in Kuwait was Iranian-made, says Italy's foreign minister
articles.summary: The drone used in the attack on Kuwait that killed two Italians was manufactured in Iran , Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said on Friday. In an interview with the Italian press, Tajani said: "According to the investigations carried out by the Kuwaitis, the drone was manufactured in Iran." The attack on Thursday also injured two other people. It drew condemnation from many countries, and some, including Syria and Saudi Arabia , blamed Iran for it. Meanwhile, Iran has denied launching…

articles.title: Israeli attacks across Gaza kill four Palestinians
articles.summary: Israeli attacks killed four Palestinians across the Gaza Strip on Friday, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. Several others, including a child, were wounded in a series of attacks across the strip. In the southern city of Rafah, Gaza's civil defence crews recovered three bodies. They also rescued two wounded people after an Israeli strike near the Muawiya Mosque on al-Bahr Street, in the west of the city. Israeli drone strike on vehicle kills Palestinian man in northern Gaza
articles.summary: A Palestinian man was killed and several others were wounded on Friday evening in an Israeli drone strike on a vehicle in the northern Gaza Strip, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. The strike hit the vehicle in the Bir al-Naaja area, west of the Jabalia refugee camp, killing Khaled Assaf, witnesses told Wafa. Some of the wounded were in serious condition.
